    The dual regular module is injective #

    For an algebra A over a commutative ring k and an injective k-module E, the module Hom_k(A, E) is an injective left A-module, with action through right multiplication on A. For a field and E = k this is the dual of the right regular module. Together with its cogenerator property, this provides injective modules containing finite-dimensional modules, without a self-injectivity assumption on the algebra.

    The action on the dual is specified through an equivariant linear equivalence, rather than installed as a global instance on all duals. This follows the convention of EFiniteCharacterizations.LinearAlgebra.Dual.RightAction.

    Main results #

    • LinearEquiv.moduleInjective_of_dual_regular: Hom_k(A, E) is injective.

    References #

    • I. Assem, D. Simson, A. Skowroński, Elements of the Representation Theory of Associative Algebras, Vol. 1, Section I.5.

    Module.Injective A Q

    For an injective k-module E, the module Hom_k(A, E), with action (a • φ) x = φ (x * a), is an injective left module over any k-algebra A.
